description: Scrape ranked US college programs and school profiles from BestColleges. Fetch ranked schools from program ranking pages, school profiles, or enumerate program pages from subject hubs.

enumTitles: Ranked schools from a program ranking page
Program pages from a subject hub
mode.title: Mode

programUri.description: Ranking page path, e.g. `computer-science/bachelors`, `nursing/masters`, `business/bachelors/finance`, or a full URL.
programUri.title: Program ranking page (mode=byProgram)

rankMax.description: Drop schools ranked better than this (e.g. `10` keeps only the top 10).
rankMax.title: Rank (max)

rankMin.description: Drop schools ranked worse than this (lower is better).
rankMin.title: Rank (min)

schoolUri.description: School profile path, e.g. `university-of-colorado-boulder`, or a full URL.
schoolUri.title: School page (mode=bySchool)

schoolYear.description: Only emit schools from this ranking year (e.g. `2026`).
schoolYear.title: Ranking school year

stateCodes.description: Only emit schools in these US states (e.g. `NY`, `CA`).
stateCodes.title: State codes

subjectUri.description: Subject hub path, e.g. `business/bachelors`, `healthcare`, `nursing`, or a full URL.
subjectUri.title: Subject hub (mode=bySubject)

title: BestColleges Scraper Input
